info.title: Reject Return
info.description: Use this API to reject a buyer's return or refund request. The valid decision depends on the current request type and status. Before calling this API, make sure the request is still awaiting the seller action that matches the decision you send.

post.description: Use this API to reject a buyer's return or refund request. The valid decision depends on the current request type and status. Before calling this API, make sure the request is still awaiting the seller action that matches the decision you send.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: idempotency_key
parameters.description: The idempotency key is a unique value generated by the client which the server uses to recognize the same request. How you create unique keys is up to you, but we suggest using UUIDs, or another random string with enough entropy to avoid collisions. Idempotency keys can be up to 255 characters long.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

decision.description:
Seller's decision for the request, available values:
- `REJECT_REFUND`: seller reject a refund-only request
- `REJECT_RETURN`: seller reject the initial return-and-refund request
- `REJECT_RECEIVED_PACKAGE`: seller reject return-and-refund request after the buyer has already shipped or handed over the item.
- `REJECT_REPLACEMENT`: seller reject replacement request
- `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`: seller offer partial refund regarding to the package item quality check

reject_reason.description: Seller's reason for rejecting the aftersales request. Use the [Get Decision Eligibility](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/69844a11eeba77049695c7f6) endpoint to retrieve the currently available rejection options for the same request, and submit the returned rejection reason name in this field. **Note**: The available decisions and rejection reasons can change depending on the current request status, so fetch eligibility again before calling this API.

comment.description: Seller's comment on the rejection decision. This is where a seller will provide more information about rejecting the request.

image_id.description: Image URI obtained from the [Upload Product Image](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509df95defece02be598a22) API.

images.description: List of images provided by the seller to support their decision to reject the return request.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
